results.response:

```python
from bisect import bisect_left

scores = [82, 91, 78, 75, 88, 92, 74, 85, 90, 89]

# 1. Find index of 85 (O(log n))
index = bisect_left(scores, 85)
print("Found at index:", index)  # 1

# 2. Insert 85 at index 4 (O(1))
